ownership: Official Florida FDACS retail food establishment records exposed by the publisher-controlled public GIS service; record acquisition rights and reuse terms have not yet been approved
allowed_use: offline contract validation with synthetic injected fixtures containing no provider records
development and verification of bounded lifecycle, cancellation, integrity, and recovery behavior
retention of synthetic run receipts inside datahub
prohibited_use: native count, ID, feature, geometry, export, or other provider record queries
claiming current operations, grocery classification, unique businesses, or nationwide completeness
collection of owner, contact, operating-hours, or FDA workplan fields
attribution: Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services, Division of Food Safety. Attribution applies only after a separately approved provider-record acquisition.
retention: Retain immutable synthetic fixtures and run-scoped receipts only for local engineering evidence. No provider record retention is authorized by this policy.
redistribution: No provider-derived record or aggregate redistribution is authorized. Synthetic test evidence may remain internal to the repository.
prerequisites: approved native acquisition plan and explicit operator authorization
